argv: --test-name-pattern=^controlled\ lifetime:\ re\-entrant\ signal\ notices\ strengthen\ or\ finish\ the\ attempt\ and\ no\ obsolete\ signal\ follows$

commands.comparisonPolicy: A complete exact-case assertion failure with this message is anticipated baseline evidence and does not skip whole current lifetime. Any other failure/incomplete/import/timeout stops. A baseline pass is recorded as such, never a fabricated failing-before claim.
